title: THE KILN YARDS
logSummary: Four wellheads on the Kiln Yards' apron, two Kilns plugged into them by turns, and a Spindle walking the shelf.

stages.note: Talk to Oro at the tube mouth
stages.log: Oro asked for the Kiln Yards' four wellheads, cold.

stages.note: Walk up into the Malpaís, bearing 050
stages.log: Walked up out of the Holds onto the cold lava.

stages.note: Reach a wellhead a Kiln is plugged into, unseen
stages.log: Reached a wellhead under a plugged Kiln, unseen.

stages.note: Brine the wellhead the Kiln is plugged into  {n} / 4
Wait for the other Kiln to plug in; quench that head
Quench the last wellhead past the Spindle
stages.log: Fourth wellhead quenched. The apron is dark.
Both Kilns stood cold. Nothing comes to the Yards to feed.

stages.note: Kindle the Brazier in the tube shelter and rest
stages.log: Rested in the lava tube by the hornitos.

stages.note: Fly home down the Scar's seven posts
stages.log: Flew the Scar's line home, seven posts.

stages.note: Tell Oro the Yards are cold
stages.log: Oro took the oxblood tiles down off the forge wall.

rewardMade: KILN-WALK: FIRE POOLS DO NO DAMAGE
closing.logEnd: The Kiln Yards are cold. The Holds' walls stand a while.

prompts.about: The Yards' own prompts, read by src/game/hour2/kiln-yards.js. {n} and {of} are the belt's Brine count and its cap.

scenes.where: the tube mouth, the forge banked, noon gone

lines: The Scar's quiet. The walls are true.
Now look up the hill, past the Rise.
Smoke on bearing 050. The Kiln Yards,
two hundred and eighty metres
and sixty-five of climb.
Four wellheads on that apron,
and the Kilns drink from them.
Every shell on the Holds is fired there.
Two of them up there now. One stands
plugged in and blind while it drinks.
The other walks, with a Spindle.
Brine within three metres of a head
while a Kiln drinks from it.
Four heads, four pots.
Three is all a belt holds. The plant
had a quench tank at the bench's
west end. If it holds brine, fill there.
Fill your belt from mine first.
And don't stand in the walking one's eye.
Three pots. Bearing 050 and up.
I'll be back before the forge is cold.

scenes.where: the tube mouth, the forge lit

lines: Four heads quenched and both Kilns
cold on the apron. Nothing walked
up the bench in the hour I watched.
Then I owe you these.
Oxblood tiles, scales cut in every one.
They hang on the Vanguard's frame,
and you don't wear that yet.
They stay on my wall until you do.
Rung 7 on the wall, waiting on 6.
I'll come back for them.
Come back for them in one piece.
I'll keep them oiled.

breaAlone.about: Brea's own turns in the field on 'The Kiln Yards': one card each, shown as a subtitle when its trigger first happens. Each trigger shows once.

lines: Three Brine on the belt.
Four heads. One trip to the tank.
Upwind all the way. The smoke leans
to 225, straight down the Scar.
Cold aa underfoot. A hundred metres
to go, and the apron above it.
Two towers, four stacks, four heads.
One Kiln plugged in, one walking.
The head's three metres off.
It hasn't turned. It can't.
One head dark. It's gone cold
where it stood. The other's moving.
Two. Each time one goes cold,
the other plugs in. Two left.
Three. One head still glowing.
Four. The apron's dark end to end.
Two Kilns, five and a half metres
each, and both of them stone cold.
Brine in the old tank, a hand deep.
Enough for three more pots.
Nothing drinks from that one.
Brine where a Kiln is plugged in.
The Spindle. Seven metres off its Kiln,
on my side of it, ring spinning.
The tube's eighty metres east,
under the hornitos. Rest there.
Seven posts down the Scar's lip.
Wind behind me, 045.
Four hundred and eighty metres
of line, and down on its foot.
